name: Bermudian Status -- Qualifying Bermudian Connection (Section 19)

qualifying_event.description: A person with a qualifying family or ancestral connection to Bermuda may apply to the Department of Immigration for Bermudian status under Section 19.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Documentation establishing the specific ancestral/family connection to a Bermudian, per the requirement list published with Form BSA04 or Form 5(2).

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a qualifying family or ancestral connection to Bermuda under Section 19 of the applicable Bermuda status legislation; must be at least 18 years old and of good conduct and character.

evidence_required.document: Form BSA04 or Form 5(2), completed in black or blue ink
Documentation of the qualifying ancestral/family connection

sources.title: Government of Bermuda -- Bermudian Status Application: four pathways (Section 19 qualifying connection, Section 19A spousal, Section 20 youth, Section 20B long-term residence), fee schedule, application process

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Bermuda's initial build -- the fourth British Overseas Territory (BOT) built this session, after Anguilla, Montserrat, and Cayman. The same key modelling decision applies and is explained once here: 'Bermudian status' is Bermuda's own local legal status (a right-of-abode-equivalent), NOT British nationality -- formal British Overseas Territories Citizenship (BOTC) is billed and administered as a separate application, 'British Naturalisation,' through the same Department of Immigration but as its own distinct process (see bm_naturalisation_botc.json). leads_to_citizenship is therefore false here, even though a descent-based route leads directly to citizenship in every non-BOT country built this session. The exact fact pattern of what counts as a 'qualifying Bermudian connection' (e.g. specific degree of ancestry, whether grandparents count) was not detailed in the fetched content -- the source pointed to downloadable forms (BSA04, Form 5(2)) with fuller requirement lists not independently retrieved in this pass; flagged as a gap rather than guessed.
